sources.title: atNorth joins Nordic Compass AI infrastructure alliance
sources.snippet: What to Watch Track whether Nordic Compass moves beyond its Gothenburg summit launch to announce concrete cross-sector projects, particularly in energy-compute coordination or shared capacity infrastructure. The broader signal is whether other regional data centre operators follow suit in forming multi-industry alliances.

sources.title: atNorth Joins Nordic Compass Alliance for AI Infrastructure
sources.snippet: As Europe races to build enough infrastructure for the AI boom, Nordic data centre operator atNorth is teaming up with some of the region's biggest industrial and energy names to help shape what comes next. sources.title: AI Gothenburg — A founder-first hub for AI builders
sources.snippet: A new home for AI founders AI Gothenburg is a founder-first hub for building new AI companies in close proximity to partners, investors and industry. The focus is on venture creation, in an environment designed to make it easier to go from idea to real company by working alongside others building with new technology.
